English: Wooden Totem
A crude wooden post carved with runes, marking the first step in honoring the spirits of the land and unifying the tribe around a powerful symbol.
Carved Idol
A finely worked wooden idol, more detailed than the first totem, reinforcing spiritual unity and deepening tribal traditions.
Totem Pavilion
A large hide pavilion is erected, sheltering sacred objects and totems, serving as a focus for tribal gatherings and rites.
Spirit Room
A sacred yurt reserved for shamanic rituals, filled with offerings and relics, strengthening the spiritual heart of the tribe.
Priests Chamber
A permanent wooden structure for the tribes shamans and priests, providing a place for council and guiding the spiritual life of the clan.
Sanctified Hall
A grand hall adorned with sacred tapestries and relics, a center for ceremony and a visible sign of the tribes faith and power.
Ancestor Hall
A revered space dedicated to the honored ancestors, housing their effigies and bones, inspiring unity and reverence among the people.
Blessed Pavilion
A richly decorated and sanctified tent complex, hosting major tribal festivals and sacred rites, drawing pilgrims from afar.
Totem Sanctuary
A fortified and sacred enclosure, housing the tribes holiest relics and serving as the spiritual and political heart of the clans domain.
Pagan Totem Hall
A monumental hall of wood and stone, adorned with the symbols of all ancestors and spirits, a wonder of faith and the unbreakable heart of the tribe.
